name: Disable Fax Service
description: Disables the Windows Fax service to stop unnecessary background activity and free system resources.

description_i18n.en: Disables the Windows Fax service to stop unnecessary background activity and free system resources.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert den Windows-Faxdienst, um unnötige Hintergrundprozesse zu stoppen und Systemressourcen freizugeben.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le service Fax de Windows pour arrêter l'activité en arrière-plan inutile et libérer des ressources système.

warnings.title: Service behavior changed
warnings.message: Applications relying on legacy fax functionality will no longer be able to use the Fax service automatically

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: The tweak modifies the startup type of the 'Fax' service to Disabled via HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Fax
